evidence_plan.requirement: Definition of an unordered text document
Existence of unordered text documents in real-world corpora

payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition of unordered text documents and confirms their existence in real-world applications such as Wikipedia documents.

claims.text: An unordered text document is one that contains sentences that are not arranged in a specific order, requiring structuring for applications like summarization and question answering.
Unordered text documents arise in real-world corpora, as evidenced by their use in applications like Wikipedia document processing.
